description: This file defines a class UriFactory implementing the UriFactoryInterface, used to create UriInterface objects from string URIs. It resides within the Http\Factory\Guzzle namespace and utilizes GuzzleHttp's Uri class for instantiation.

classes.name: UriFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating UriInterface instances from string URIs, implementing the UriFactoryInterface.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a new UriInterface object from the provided URI string, defaulting to an empty string if none is provided.
